title: SPELLSTACK
oneLiner: Two wizards duel through a haunted library, hurling fireballs and outsmarting each other before the shelves collapse.
mechanics: Player one is the crimson wizard; player two is the azure wizard.
Move around the single library arena and launch bouncing fireballs at the rival.
Fireballs ignite book piles, creating temporary walls and dangerous flames.
A shrinking safe area and falling books prevent stalling; the last wizard standing wins.
lose: Lose all three hearts from enemy fireballs, flames, or falling books.
scoring: Score for striking the rival, with bonus points for defeating them before the arena closes.
